questions.stem: She said she ____ (have) a lot of homework to do.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，从句要退一格
进行时要退成过去进行时

questions.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，从句的一般现在时 has 退成 had。

questions.stem: They told us they ____ (be) in Beijing last year.

options.distractor: 现在完成时要退成过去完成时

questions.explanation: 从句里有 last year，本身就用过去时 were，与主句呼应一致。

questions.stem: He asked me where I ____ (go) the next day.

options.distractor: the next day 表示当时之后的将来
主句是过去时，will 要退成 would

questions.explanation: 主句 asked 是过去时，“第二天要去”用 would go。

questions.stem: The teacher said light ____ (travel) much faster than sound.
questions.explanation: 光速是客观真理，不管主句什么时态，都用一般现在时 travels。

options.text: He said he was ill yesterday.
She said she would come the next day.
The teacher said the sun rose in the east.
They said they were very busy.

questions.explanation: 太阳东升是客观真理，即使主句是过去时也要用 rises。

options.distractor: next 表示当时之后，不是已经发生

questions.explanation: 主句 didn't know 是过去时，“接下来会发生什么”用 would happen。
